theme_and_archetype.description: A high-end, premium clinical SaaS platform. Combines the moody, jewel-like aesthetic of luxury platforms with the high-contrast data clarity needed for medical/nutrition analysis. Avoids the 'fintech-bro' look by maintaining clinical precision and using soft, elegant typography.

headings.usage: Used for all page titles, hero text, and major section headers to provide a sleek, tech-forward premium feel.

body.usage: Used for all body copy, data tables, labels, and forms. Provides excellent legibility for dense clinical data.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Allow data to breathe. Dense layouts are only for the control-room dashboard views.

glassmorphism.usage: Overlapping elements, sticky headers, modals, floating action bars.

motion.no_flash: opacity changes should use ease-in-out to prevent flashing

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#7B61FF] to-[#1DB97E] text-white rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-semibold hover:-translate-y-0.5 shadow-[0_4px_14px_0_rgba(123,97,255,0.3)] transition-all duration-300 ease-out
buttons.secondary: bg-[#161B22] border border-white/[0.08] text-white hover:bg-[#1DB97E]/10 hover:border-[#1DB97E]/50 rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-semibold transition-all duration-200 ease-out
buttons.ghost: text-white/70 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-all

status_badges.base: px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide inline-flex items-center gap-1.5

tables.header: bg-[#161B22] text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400 font-semibold border-b border-white/[0.08] p-4
tables.row: even:bg-[#0A0F14] odd:bg-[#0D1117] hover:bg-white/[0.02] transition-colors border-b border-white/[0.04]

form_inputs.base: w-full bg-[#0A0F14] border border-white/[0.08] rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder-gray-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#7B61FF]/50 focus:border-[#7B61FF] transition-all duration-200
form_inputs.label: block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-300 mb-2

charts.tooltip: bg-[#161B22]/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 text-white rounded-lg p-3 shadow-xl

landing_page.hero: Dark premium aesthetic. Headline uses Outfit. Background has subtle glowing orbs of #7B61FF and #1DB97E (achieved via CSS radial-gradients with blur). Floating glassmorphic cards showing 'AI Analysis' and 'Patient Progress'.
landing_page.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header with 'Login' and 'Agendar Consulta' CTAs.

patient_form.layout: Centered form container with step indicators.
patient_form.features: Progress bar (gradient fill). Auto-save indicator (subtle text top right). 15 steps paginated to avoid overwhelming the user. Inputs are large and tactile.

bubbles.ai: bg-[#161B22] border border-[#7B61FF]/20 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm p-4 text-gray-200 shadow-sm
bubbles.user: bg-[#7B61FF] text-white rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm p-4 shadow-md

scheduling.layout: Calendar grid overlaying standard dashboard or modal.
scheduling.components: Date picker using dark-themed grid. Time slots as pill buttons. Unavailable slots disabled with opacity-30.

login.layout: Split screen or centered glass card over abstract gradient background.
login.styling: Inputs use focus rings. Primary gradient button for Login.

nutritionist_dashboard.layout: Dense Control-Room grid (Archetype 4 style applied to dark theme).
nutritionist_dashboard.kpi_cards: 4 columns. Displaying 'Novos Pacientes', 'Consultas Hoje', 'Faturamento'. Uses subtle icons.
nutritionist_dashboard.recent_patients: Data table with alternating rows (#0D1117 / #0A0F14) and status badges.

patient_detail.layout: Sidebar for navigation (Anamnesis, AI, Anthropometry, Meal Plan) + Main content area.
patient_detail.ai_analysis: Glassmorphism card with warning coral/amber highlights for risk flags. Uses textual summary + bullet points.

anthropometry.layout: Complex data entry grid + Chart visualization.
anthropometry.protocols: Tabs for Pollock 7, Faulkner, etc. Input fields grouped cleanly. Recharts line graph showing evolution over time.

comparative_evaluations.design: Visual arrows (Teal for improvement, Coral for regression) between metrics. AI narrative in a highlighted glass card below the metrics.

meal_plan.layout: Timeline or card-based list by hour.
meal_plan.cards: Each meal is a #161B22 card with macros broken down into pill badges (PTN, CHO, LIP). Summary header with total Kcal.

media.philosophy: Images should feel dark, moody, premium, and healthy. Avoid bright white clinical stock photos. Embrace deep shadows and rich food colors.

images.description: Abstract dark background with subtle shapes.
Abstract artwork featuring dynamic teal light streaks, modern atmosphere.
Moody food photo featuring blackberries, blueberries on dark slate.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text against #0D1117 and #161B22 meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use white or bright gray for primary text.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, table rows, badges) MUST include data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case based on role. e.g., data-testid='submit-anamnesis-button', data-testid='patient-row-status-badge'.
